candidates.snippet: Marcelo Garcia, a multiple-time ADCC and World champion, did not have a smooth start. On The North South Project podcast, he described the loss at his first World Championship that shaped how he handles setbacks. Garcia fell for Jiu-Jitsu within a week. In his small town, classes ran three times a week, and he marked training days on a calendar: I was already, like, I can’t wait to the next day and there was no class next day because there was only three class a week… During the weekend, I was, like, I can’t believe it’s a weekend. candidates.title: MMA Fighter Asks Dana White For A $100K Bonus To Help Pay For His Wedding After UFC Debut Win
candidates.snippet: Joe Kropschot submitted Nick Klein with an inverted triangle at UFC Vegas 123, then used his post-fight interview to ask Dana White for money. The 31-year-old is getting married five days after his Octagon debut, and he made his pitch to Daniel Cormier on camera: Man, it feels great to get the finish. I need the extra money. I’m getting married five days after this with my fiancée. We’ve been together since I was 16. So maybe an extra 100K bonus would help a lot with that.
